name: Cymatics
description: The first clip is a layer of sand on a vibrating plate: it shivers, then runs together into the symmetric lines of a sound figure, uncovering the second clip beneath as the plate, before the lines thin out and their grains hop off. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: mode_x
params.description: Vibration mode across the plate: more nodal lines with a larger value

params.name: mode_y
params.description: Vibration mode along the plate: more nodal lines with a larger value

params.name: line_width
params.description: Width of the lines of sand once gathered
